title: I can't install the 'Lighthouse' extension in Chrome
description: I'm trying to install the Lighthouse extension for performance testing, but I'm getting a 'blocked by organization policy' warning.

worklogs.description: Helped the user fill out the Browser Extension Request form.
After Information Security approval, the extension was added to the GPO whitelist.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Lighthouse has been added to the allow-list. Restart Chrome and the extension will be visible in the store.

resolutionNote: The Lighthouse extension was added to the allow-list with Information Security approval and enabled on the user's device.
